description: This Java interface defines the SearchResult entity used for representing search query results, including methods for pagination, item retrieval, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: An interface representing the results of a search query, including pagination and JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: SearchResult.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class enumerating the JSON fields of SearchResult, such as items, nextPageOffset, cursor, and schema version.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing SearchResult instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current SearchResult's properties.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the search result items as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the offset of the next page, or empty if none.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cursor for the next page.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Indicates whether there is a next page of results.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the search result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the search result contains no items.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of the search result items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject with specified schema version and field selector.
